description: AI coding assistant CLI (TUI) powered by DeepSeek models, with multi-provider support

modules.name: agent
modules.description: Core do agente LLM: loop principal, LLM client factory, steering, sessões, checkpoints, compactação, custo, auditoria e integração MCP

submodules.name: providers
submodules.description: Providers de LLM: bedrock, vertex, proxy (servidor Hono local com browser pool)

modules.name: tools
modules.description: Ferramentas do agente: Git, Glob, Grep, Shell, ReadFile, WriteFile, PatchFile, SubAgent, Todo, WebFetch, Introspect, UpdateKnowledge

modules.name: commands
modules.description: Slash commands da CLI: model, clear, compact, plan, review, agent, vim, checkpoint, sessions, undo, retry, cost, permissions, stats, etc.

modules.name: ink
modules.description: Fork customizado do Ink (React TUI renderer): componentes, layout engine (Yoga), event system, ANSI parsing, terminal I/O

modules.name: ui
modules.description: Componentes de aplicação: App, InputBox, messages, setup, StatusBar, vim mode, interaction modes

modules.name: hooks
modules.description: Sistema de hooks extensível (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SessionStart) com matcher e executor

modules.name: permissions
modules.description: Sistema de permissões (allow/deny patterns) para controle de ferramentas

modules.name: settings
modules.description: Carregamento e merge hierárquico de settings (user → project → local)

modules.name: services
modules.description: Serviços: auto-compact (summary prompt), MCP re-export, session management

modules.name: state
modules.description: State management centralizado com store e selectors

modules.name: utils
modules.description: Utilitários: credentials, fs, env, debug, semver, auto-update, sliceAnsi

modules.name: constants
modules.description: Constantes globais: product name, tool names, UI constants, agent defaults

organization_suggestion.rationale: Pastas top-level em src/ representam domínios claros e independentes: agent, tools, commands, ink, ui, hooks, permissions, settings, services, state
